question: The presiding deity of the Dakshineswar Temple in Kolkata is Goddess _______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bhavatarini Kali.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **presiding deity of Dakshineswar temple** is **Bhavatarini Kali**, a form of** Adi Parashakti Kali**.
 
• The temple is one of the holiest places in Bengal **founded** by **Rani Rashmoni.**
